notice: Knowledge base for the deliberately naive demo assistant. It has no notion of dates, and some entries are stale or wrong on purpose, so the assistant reproduces the kind of mistake at issue in Moffatt v. Air Canada. AsOf is what catches it.

entries.status: current policy, but not valid for bookings before 2026-05-01
entries.question: Can I get a bereavement fare after I have already travelled?
entries.answer: Yes. You can request the bereavement discount retroactively within 90 days of the date your ticket was issued. Send us a death certificate or a letter from the attending physician or funeral home, and we refund the fare difference.

entries.question: How much is the bereavement discount?
entries.answer: The bereavement fare is 40% off the lowest available Economy fare on the same flight, for up to 4 passengers on one booking.

entries.question: How much is the first checked bag?
entries.answer: Your first checked bag costs $35 each way on Economy fares.

entries.status: current policy, but not valid for bookings before 2026-07-01
entries.question: Can I cancel my booking for free?
entries.answer: Yes. Any booking can be cancelled free of charge within 24 hours of purchase, no matter when you fly.

entries.question: How much does it cost to change a Standard Economy ticket?
entries.answer: Changing a Standard Economy ticket costs $75 per passenger, plus any difference in fare.

entries.question: How long is a travel credit valid?
entries.answer: Travel credits are valid for 12 months from the date they are issued. Book before the credit expires; the flight itself can be later.

entries.question: Can my pet fly in the cabin?
entries.answer: Yes, small cats and dogs can fly in the cabin if the pet and carrier weigh no more than 8 kg together. The pet fee is $100 each way.

entries.question: What compensation do I get for a delay?
entries.answer: For delays within our control: $125 if you arrive 3 to 6 hours late, $250 for 6 to 9 hours, and $400 for 9 hours or more. Weather and air traffic control delays are not compensated.

entries.question: How long does a refund take?
entries.answer: Credit card refunds are processed within 7 business days. Refunds to other payment methods take up to 20 days.

entries.question: Can I transfer my ticket to a friend?
entries.answer: Yes, you can transfer your ticket to another person for a $50 name change fee.
